decision: Use the existing ten acceptance checks for release
why: The customer journey includes hardware and hosted checks in addition to fixtures.

decision: Pass database and job ID as child process arguments
why: The recovery fixture child previously received an undefined path.

decision: Recreate the browser and kill the research API process while a job runs
why: A tab refresh alone cannot prove fresh login and crash recovery.
result: Signed-in owner recovered chart and matching download; second account denied

decision: Keep active research attached to its approved brief during spoken or typed status questions
why: An unrecognized status question could previously supersede the active job.
result: English and Hindi questions preserved job and brief IDs after process restart

decision: Deploy one ECS task on the EBS-backed writer using four immutable images
why: SQLite ownership survives task restarts. The CloudWatch query separates request time from worker duration.

decision: Accept spoken progress on the live provider and leave physical multilingual interruption open
why: The studio played a real status reply while the approved job was running. Hindi recognition errors and room acoustics need a physical rehearsal.
